details:
Project Description: Junior Astronaut Training Program

Junior Astronaut Training Program is an interactive educational application designed for children and students to explore space and experience the basics of astronaut training in an enjoyable and engaging way.

The program combines scientific information, educational games, virtual simulations, and interactive challenges to introduce users to the solar system, planets, stars, galaxies, and the responsibilities of astronauts during space missions.

It includes several sections, such as Space Learning, Astronaut Training, Space Challenges, and Progress Tracking. Through these activities, users can test their knowledge, complete virtual missions, solve problems, and develop important skills such as critical thinking, concentration, and decision-making.

The main goal of this project is to make space education more accessible, interactive, and enjoyable while encouraging curiosity, creativity, and scientific exploration among young learners.
